main_text.l: runt tamen inter se singula: quemadmodum Specie,
propter diversitatem Materia; sic & Gradu,
quantum ad obligandi vim. Sunt autem illa in
triplici potissimum discrimine. Quædam enim
constanter obligant, quorum rursus sunt duo ge-
nera: unum eorum quorum obligatio oritur ex
potestate alterius, ut Leges humanæ, mandata Paren-
tum, Dominorum, &c. Alterum eorum quorum
obligatio oritur ex libera propriæ Voluntatis ele-
ctione, ut Vota, Juramenta, Pacta, Promissa, & his
similia: quædam verò ex accidenti tantùm obli-
gant & velut ambulatoriè, pro hic & nunc, secun-
dùm exigentiam circumstantiarum; ut Lex sive
i.
III. Postulat ordinis ratio, ut à primo illo ge-
nere ordinamur, in quo familiam ducunt Leges Hu-
manæ. De quarum obligatione quæ à nobis di-
cendi erunt, ad duas hasce quæstiones revocari
possint universa. An sc. obligent conscientias Le-
ges humanæ? & Quatenus obligent? Casuum ple-
rorumque particularium determinatio ad posterio-
rem quæstionem magis pertinet; de quâ (si Deus
annuerit) instituentur futuræ aliquot prælectiones:
priorem solam hoc tempore attingemus, hanc sc.
An Leges humanæ obligent Conscientias: Subjectum
quæstionis non indiget multa explicatione. Lex,
sive primò à {1}legendo, i. e. eligendo dicto electivè,
ut Ciceroni placuit, quòd Legislatores ea quæ Reip-
ublicæ magis utilia fore judicabant eligerent:
sive quod alii malunt, secundò, à legendo item,
sed in alia significatione, eâque passivè acceptâ,
quod oporteret Leges, mox ubi latæ essent, æneis
tabulis incisas, autalias perscriptas & columnis ap-
pensas proponi in publico, ut à populo legeret-
ur; sive denique ex aliorum mente tertiò, à {2}li-
gando, quòd subditos ad eos observandum

page.notes: Right margin notes: "1.", "2.", "3." beside the first paragraph are section numbers printed in the margin. "I." beside "Lex" is a marginal section number. Note 1 (margin, bottom right), transcribed as printed but doubtful: "Dd Gut[?] vim in Lege[?] penimus. Cic. I. de Legib." The first words are hard to read and may be "Dū su̇t" or similar. Note 2 (margin, bottom right): "Aquin. I. 2. qu. 92[?] art. 16[?]. Biel. 6. distinct. 3. 37. art 1." The numbers 92 and 16 are uncertain. "distinct." is printed with a long-s form. Running head and catchword "di" are as read; the catchword is uncertain. Left edge of the scan shows the neighbouring page and is not transcribed. Faint show-through at the top right is excluded.
